clue.text: A member on the outside of chamber might suffer this

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after, so the A and member pieces follow the chamber letters
the outside of a word is its first and last letters, here those of chamber

parts.note: MP is short for Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: A Member of Parliament stuck outside the debating chamber might be in some discomfort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'member' reads as a politician, but the definition plays on its other sense, a limb: a limb is what suffers the painful spasm. The outside of 'chamber' gives CR.
explanation.definitionFit: A cramp is a sudden painful muscle spasm, the kind of thing a limb might suffer.

clue.text: Long distance traveller on a custom machine

indicators.note: to machine is to work or shape something, so the letters of on a custom are reshaped

explanation.surface: Someone making a long trip aboard a specially built vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'machine' looks like a noun, a custom-built vehicle, but it is the verb that reworks ON A CUSTOM.
explanation.definitionFit: A Soviet or Russian space traveller covers vast distances in orbit.

clue.text: Allow a day — the motorway traffic starts

parts.note: the M1 is Britain's main north-south motorway, written here with the figure 1 as the letter I

indicators.note: starts means the opening letter of the word traffic

explanation.surface: Someone grants a day before motorway traffic gets going.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds; crosswords often treat its 1 as the letter I. 'starts' takes the first letter of 'traffic', T.
explanation.definitionFit: To admit someone is to let them in, so it is a synonym for permit or let.

clue.text: A game of cards with no top on is exciting

indicators.note: exciting means stirring up, so the letters of no top on are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A card game where nobody wears a top would certainly be thrilling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no top on' paints a risqué picture, but those three words are only the letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Pontoon is the British name for the card game also called blackjack or twenty-one.

clue.text: Half left after long-standing account

indicators.note: after places the half of left behind the long-standing piece

parts.note: a chronic condition is one that has lasted a long time

indicators.note: Half takes the first two of the four letters of left

explanation.surface: A half-share was left after a long-running bank account closed.
explanation.definitionFit: A chronicle is a historical record or narrative of events, that is, an account of them.

clue.text: Beech is elegant, and has what a carpenter needs

indicators.note: has means the words Beech is elegant contain the letters as a run

explanation.surface: A woodworker admiring a fine piece of beech and the tool for shaping it.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits across the words: beeCH IS ELegant.
explanation.definitionFit: A chisel is a bladed tool for cutting and shaping wood, essential kit for a woodworker.

clue.text: Sort of wine with depth can be cool

parts.note: a reserve wine is one aged and held back as a better vintage

explanation.surface: A wine with real depth can be served chilled.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cool' reads as the temperature to serve the wine, but it means aloof in manner.
explanation.definitionFit: A reserved person is distant and restrained, the same as being cool or standoffish.

clue.text: Book new city on the west coast

parts.note: novel means new or original
LA is Los Angeles, the big city on the US west coast

explanation.surface: Someone books a trip to a fresh destination on the Pacific coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Book' looks like a verb for making a reservation; it is the noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A novella is a short novel, a book between a short story and a full-length novel in size.

clue.text: Big-headed Tory sitting down talking

parts.note: CON is short for Conservative, the party of the Tories

indicators.note: talking means the word for sitting down is taken as spoken, and its sound is spelt another way

parts.note: sitting down means seated

explanation.surface: A self-important Conservative MP holds forth from a seated position.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone conceited has an inflated opinion of themselves, which is what big-headed means.

clue.text: Stops going topless and relaxes

indicators.note: going topless means the word loses its first letter, its top in a down answer

parts.note: ceases means stops

explanation.surface: Someone stops wearing a top and feels more at ease.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going topless' drops the C of CEASES.
explanation.definitionFit: Eases means loosens or lets up, as relaxes does.

clue.text: Calls back, and nervous reactions result in different interpretations of language used

indicators.note: back means the word for calls is read from right to left

parts.note: to call someone something is to name them, so calls gives names
tics are involuntary twitches caused by nerves

explanation.surface: Phone calls returned and jittery responses lead to everyone reading the words differently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns NAMES into SEMAN. 'Calls back' looks like returning phone calls.
explanation.definitionFit: Semantics is the study of meaning in words, including the different ways they can be read.

clue.text: Star returning after victory in Europe

definitions.text: Star returning after victory in Europe

indicators.note: after places the turned star behind the victory letters

parts.note: VE Day marked victory in Europe in 1945

indicators.note: returning means the word for star is read in the opposite direction

parts.note: the sun is our own star

explanation.surface: A celebrity comes home after a triumph on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returning' turns SUN into NUS. The planet is popularly called the morning or evening star, which makes the whole clue its definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Venus is the bright planet popularly called the evening star, which returns to the sky after sunset.

clue.text: The consequence of unfashionable compiler accepting company

indicators.note: accepting means the first pieces take the company letters inside them

parts.note: out means no longer in fashion
the compiler is the setter, who refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: What happens when a setter who is past it takes on a business.
explanation.walkthrough: In crosswords the setter (the compiler) often refers to themselves, so compiler gives ME.
explanation.definitionFit: An outcome is the result of something, so it is a synonym for consequence.

clue.text: The queen rides in an expensive car and waves

indicators.note: rides in means the queen's letters are placed inside the car

parts.note: a Rolls is a Rolls-Royce, a famously expensive car
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, the late Queen

explanation.surface: The monarch travels in her luxury car and waves to the crowd.
explanation.walkthrough: 'waves' reads as the royal greeting, but it is the noun: large breaking waves.
explanation.definitionFit: Rollers are long heavy waves that roll in towards the shore.

clue.text: A horse that can add up

parts.note: a mount is a horse that is ridden

explanation.surface: A clever horse able to do arithmetic.
explanation.walkthrough: To amount to something is to add up to it.
explanation.definitionFit: To amount means to total or come to, as figures add up to a sum.

clue.text: Concluded the company bosses were ott

parts.note: over means finished or concluded
the board is the group of directors running a company

explanation.surface: The directors were overreaching and it ended.
explanation.walkthrough: OTT is short for over the top, excessive.
explanation.definitionFit: To go overboard is to go too far, which is being excessive or over the top.

clue.text: Left-wing thespian and editor

parts.note: red is used for left-wing or socialist politics
a thespian is an actor

explanation.surface: A socialist performer who also edits.
explanation.definitionFit: A redactor prepares text for publication, revising and correcting it: an editor.

clue.text: The explanation for a relation misbehaving

indicators.note: misbehaving suggests letters acting up and moving out of their order

explanation.surface: Why a family member is behaving badly.
explanation.definitionFit: A rationale is the reasoning or justification behind something.

clue.text: Privately, at home, supporters raised cover for credit

parts.note: in means at home, as in staying in

indicators.note: cover for means the supporters' letters wrap around the credit letters
raised in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so it is turned round

parts.note: tees are the pegs that support golf balls

explanation.surface: At home, fans are discreetly raising money to cover an overdraft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporters' suggests fans, but here they are golf tees; 'raised' turns them upwards, as a down clue reads, and 'cover for' wraps them round the credit abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something in secret means doing it out of public view, that is, privately.

clue.text: Taking steps to put energy into doing business

indicators.note: into means energy's letter is placed inside the business word

parts.note: trading means doing business
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Advice to put more effort into running a business.
explanation.definitionFit: Treading means walking or stepping, setting your feet down one after another.

clue.text: One can't settle for current monarch

parts.note: a drift is a flow or current of water or air
ER stands for Elizabeth Regina, a monarch

explanation.surface: A sovereign who cannot settle and goes with the flow.
explanation.definitionFit: A drifter is a person who moves from place to place without a fixed home or job.

clue.text: Criminal ring with sex appeal

parts.note: a band is a ring, as a wedding band
it was a slang term for sex appeal, as in the It girl

explanation.surface: A gang of crooks with plenty of glamour.
explanation.definitionFit: A bandit is a robber or outlaw, a kind of criminal.

clue.text: Going round in two minds? Not Val!

indicators.note: Not means the name that follows is removed from the longer word

parts.note: ambivalent means undecided, in two minds

explanation.surface: Someone dithering, unsure, though it is not Val who is undecided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not Val!' takes VAL out of AMBIVALENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Ambient means surrounding or encompassing, as ambient air goes all round you.

clue.text: Inclined to be finished on time

indicators.note: on means the finished word comes next to the time letter

parts.note: ended means finished

explanation.surface: Someone tends to be done punctually.
explanation.definitionFit: Tended means was disposed or apt to do something, as inclined does.

clue.text: Rubs heartily, covering with goo — that's awesome!

indicators.note: covering means the goo word goes round the heart of rubs

parts.note: slime is sticky goo

indicators.note: heartily means taking the middle letters of rubs

explanation.surface: An enthusiastic rubdown with gloop is wonderful.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heartily' takes the middle letters of 'Rubs', UB.
explanation.definitionFit: Sublime means of such beauty or grandeur as to inspire awe.

clue.text: 13 accepts show of hesitation, seeing something in the blood

indicators.note: accepts means the total takes the hesitation letters inside

parts.note: 13 points to the answer of 13 Across, a total, which is a synonym of sum
er is the sound people make when hesitating

explanation.surface: A tally that allows for doubt finds something in the bloodstream.
explanation.definitionFit: Serum is the clear fluid part of the blood left after clotting.

clue.text: Oriental doctor has a right turn, and gets a ban

parts.note: E is short for east, the Orient
MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's degree
a go is a turn, as in your go

explanation.surface: An Eastern doctor turns right and finds himself banned.
explanation.definitionFit: An embargo is an official prohibition, especially on trade.

clue.text: Implements used by king in other eras

indicators.note: in means the king's letter goes inside the rearranged letters
other means the letters of eras are put into a different order

parts.note: K is the abbreviation for king in chess

explanation.surface: Tools a king used in times gone by.
explanation.walkthrough: 'other' rearranges ERAS to RAES, and K goes inside.
explanation.definitionFit: Rakes are garden tools with long handles and a toothed head.

clue.text: Respond and cater for change

indicators.note: for change says the letters of cater are to be swapped round

explanation.surface: Answer and supply food for a change.
explanation.definitionFit: To react is to respond to something that happens.

clue.text: American growth perhaps irked Cuba

indicators.note: perhaps suggests the letters of irked Cuba might be arranged another way

explanation.surface: An American policy that may have annoyed Havana.
explanation.walkthrough: 'growth' is a plant, not economic expansion.
explanation.definitionFit: Rudbeckia is a North American flowering plant, the black-eyed Susan.

clue.text: Fashion considered to be toned down

parts.note: a mode is a fashion or style
rated means judged or considered

explanation.surface: A fashion thought to be quieter.
explanation.definitionFit: Moderated means made less extreme or intense, softened.

clue.text: A brief experience of smack?

explanation.surface: Is a small sample all one gets of a slap?
explanation.definitionFit: A taste is a brief sample of something; to smack of something is to have a taste of it, so smack is a taste or flavour.
